Resolve Wave 3 audit findings:
1. In bin/agb.mjs:
   - Remove unused import of @adlc/core around line 8 to maintain zero runtime bundle dependencies.
2. In templates/plan.example.json:
   - Update mid tier model candidates around line 32 to include a valid Claude model ('claude-sonnet-5-5-high') alongside Gemini candidates.
3. In scripts/release-audit-collect.mjs:
   - Update surface:skills label in UNITS on line 122 to: 'Shipped skills (modernize, release, release-audit) and their scripts'.
4. Clean working tree and archive completed tickets:
   - Archive completed PR #120 issue tickets from the active store to ticket-archive so that git status is clean and stale tickets do not accumulate rails.

Verification: npm test && node bin/agb.mjs validate templates/plan.example.json && git status --porcelain
title: Wave 3: CLI, Templates, Skills Label, and Ticket Archive
